_comment: GitHub repository ruleset for the default branch (ADR-0004). The canonical successor to classic branch protection — layerable, readable by all developers, most-restrictive-wins. Apply with docs/governance/apply-ruleset.sh (idempotent gh api). Do NOT also configure classic branch protection on the same branch — two layers = two sources of truth; migrate OFF classic. require_code_owner_review pairs with .github/CODEOWNERS to make promotion authority mechanical. NOTE: while the admin set is a single person, the required review is a self-approval no-op (it binds when a second admin joins). bypass_actors lists the repo-admin role so the owner can still ship waves directly during the solo phase; tighten it when the team grows.
name: main-protection
